about: Named exceptions to the portal lint (tools/portals.mjs § the lint; tools/mark-lint.mjs § 10). The rules carry no exceptions of their own (Darko, 2026-10-13, WLD-5): a portal that strands whoever takes it refuses the crossing. An entry here lets ONE finding through, by name: { mark, rule, by, why }, appended by whoever answers for it, and mark-lint prints it as a warning on every run, so the record shows the door was let through and by whom. An entry that excuses nothing is warned about too. Rules: into-names-a-mark, lands-at-names-a-mark, lands-at-reaches-into, exit-never-opposed, path-to-an-exit, rooms-do-not-overlap.
